title: Ken Burns still
description: A still fills the whole frame and the camera pushes in very slowly towards a point you choose (CSS @keyframes on transform, no library). A thin band at the bottom carries a gold line, a label and one line; only the band is darkened. For a photo of a person give the face box: the caption becomes a corner column on the free side of the person and the picture is never shown above its own size.

props.src: required, a picture, or a clip (mp4/webm) that plays while the camera pushes in
props.text: required, one line in the caption band: what the picture is
props.label: small caps beside it
props.focus: [x, y] in 0..1 of the picture: where the camera pushes in (default: the centre, or the face)
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 when the picture shows a person
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the whole person (guessed from the face when missing)
props.side: left or right: force the side of the caption beside a person (default: the wider free side)
props.poster: still shown before a clip loads
